name: Inkling
description: Small spell-creatures summoned by Silverquill students from insults and sounds; Jilesa uses them to scout the maze.

description_citations.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Off the Record
description_citations.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Off the Record" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Jilesa summons inklings to run the maze while Esmun maps their path, with Zarek lending power.
timeline.quote: The maze's energy-sapping eventually dispelled the inklings, until only one remained.
